intelligence.title: Top queries

query.label: Query
query.help: Normalized query text — literal values are replaced with $1, $2, ... by pg_stat_statements.

calls.label: Calls
calls.help: How many times this query has run since stats were last reset.

total.label: Total
total.help: Total time spent executing this query across all its calls combined — the best single number for "which query costs the most."

rows.label: Rows
rows.help: Total rows returned or affected across all calls combined.

intelligence.resetConfirmMessage: This clears pg_stat_statements for the whole server. The top-queries list will start empty again.

history.emptyBody: This fills in once the query history collector has run a few cycles (every 5 minutes) against queries with recent activity in pg_stat_statements.
history.footnote: The shaded band on the latency chart is this query's own normal range (average ± {{multiplier}}× standard deviation, computed from the history shown) — a point above it means that 5-minute collection interval ran unusually slow on average, not necessarily any single execution within it.

picker.hint: Compare up to {{max}} queries at once.

explain.description: Paste a read-only SELECT query — this actually runs it, so only SELECT / WITH queries are accepted.
explain.noFindings: No red flags found in this plan.
explain.viewerDescription: pev2 by Dalibo — node timings, buffers and the critical path of this EXPLAIN ANALYZE run.

params.note: This query has parameter placeholders — pg_stat_statements replaces literal values with these before storing the query. Fill in a value for each one exactly as you'd write it in SQL (e.g. 42, 'active', now()) before running it.
